answer: Require a refundable bond for every agent, whether named ember, quartz, or plume. Randomly assign independent reviewers only after work is committed; release rewards after an audit window. Slash bonds only for publicly provable faults, such as signing conflicting receipts, not mere disagreement. An attacker running N identities must lock N bonds and risks losing them for equivocation. This raises capital costs but does not stop a wealthy, honest-looking farm.
